title: New Ship-To Setup Conditions and Opening Level
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — conditions for opening a new delivery location.**

1. A new ship-to is opened only for a customer whose Commercial Credit Account status is active.
2. The ship-to opens within the setup period of business days set for the level (the setup column of the service level schedule) at the requested service level when its entry gate is met (including the portfolio allowance under the ship-to portfolio principles), otherwise at the highest level whose entry gate is met; Route Delivery, Premier Route and Dedicated Delivery levels are available only for a delivery ZIP code inside a Corbett branch route territory.
3. A ship-to request may be cancelled by the customer before it opens.

### The credit account condition

The condition in clause 1 is read from the system record of the customer's Commercial Credit Account before the request is acted on: the account's status must be active. What the customer says about the account does not replace that record.

| Commercial Credit Account status on record | New ship-to under clause 1 |
|---|---|
| active | may be opened |
| any other status (for example on hold, in collections or closed) | not opened |

### The opening level

- Requested level's entry gate met: the ship-to opens at the requested level.
- Requested level's entry gate not met: it opens at the highest level whose entry gate is met.
- A delivery ZIP outside every Corbett branch route territory: Route Delivery, Premier Route and Dedicated Delivery levels are not available to it.

*Hypothetical case:* a request for a route level at a ZIP outside every route territory, where the customer's credit account is active, cannot open at any route level; it opens at the highest of the other levels whose entry gate is met.
